description: Fragment of a clay tablet, the end of obverse and the tipper part of reverse are wanting; out of the upper part of obverse a large piece is broken out, and on its lower part, the lines are mutilated at their beginnings, part of a text containing astrological forecasts, which are chiefly taken from observations of the moon, obverse, line 1, which is separated from the following text by a division-rule, Neo-Assyrian.

references.notes: + K 2195 + K 3510) Weidner Babyl. 6 8ff. Livingstone MMEW 22ff.
